title.narrative: Competitiveness and Productive Diversification Support Program
Programa de Apoyo a la Competitividad y la Diversificacin Productiva

description.narrative: El objetivo general de la serie programtica es promover la transformacin productiva a travs de la diversificacin econmica, la competitividad de sectores estratgicos y la atencin de proyectos transversales que representan grandes desafos pas asociados a la transformacin productiva. El objetivo de la primera operacin individual es apoyar la puesta en marcha de un fondo para impulsar iniciativas pblicas y pblico-privadas en sectores estratgicos que promuevan la transformacin productiva. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mantener un entorno macroeconmico y estable; (ii) consolidar una nueva estructura institucional para la identificacin y financiamiento de inversiones estratgicas para la competitividad de sectores de alto potencial de crecimiento en la economa yo para abordar grandes desafos pas asociados a la transformacin productiva; (iii) disear, desarrollar y consolidar los mecanismos de intervenciones pblico-privadas de apoyo a la productividad en los sectores estratgicos y en sectores transversales que representan grandes desafos pas asociados a la transformacin productiva; y (iv) establecer mecanismos de monitoreo y evaluacin que permitan asegurar la correcta ejecucin de los proyectos y el cumplimiento de sus objetivos.

The general objective of the programmatic series is to promote productive transformation through economic diversification, improving the competitiveness of strategic sectors, and support for crosscutting projects representing major country challenges associated with productive transformation. The objective of the first individual operation is to support the implementation of a fund to promote public and public-private initiatives in strategic sectors that promote productive transformation. The specific objectives are to: (i) maintain a stable macroeconomic environment; (ii) consolidate a new institutional structure to identify and finance strategic investments for competitiveness in sectors with a high potential for economic growth andor to address major country challenges associated with productive transformation; (iii) design, develop, and consolidate public-private intervention mechanisms to support productivity in strategic and crosscutting sectors that represent major country challenges associated with productive transformation; and (iv) establish monitoring and evaluation mechanisms to ensure proper execution of projects and fulfillment of their objectives. This loan is the first of two consecutive operations that are linked technically but financed independently under the programmatic policybased loan (PBP) modality.
